reviews.author: Halee Powell
reviews.text: Super nice guys, and very professional. They did an awesome job putting dual exhaust on our truck. We drove all the way from Drexel, bc our local muffler shop was very hateful. I would 100% use them again, and recommend them to anyone!!

reviews.author: daphne caldwell
reviews.text: Exceptional. Very nice gentleman. So good to be able to trust the place that is working on your car. He has very fair prices. My daughters car runs great. Thank you A-1 muffler service.

reviews.author: Lasasha Steptoe
reviews.text: Great service but if you have anything of value and want to keep it do not leave it inside your car. I called to let the owner know some things were taken out of my car and he became irate teeming at me over the phone i wasn’t asking for compensation or anything just letting him know what type of employees are working him and of course I’m lying. Take any valuable or sentimental possessions out of your vehicle before drop off

reviews.author: Luke Moore
reviews.text: Had my brakes go out on my truck, caliper seized, then broke free and ripped the hose, lost pressure and hope for the day. Ray took the truck immediately, had a price within 30 minutes and fixed it without sending me to the poor house. Good shop, better folks, great service.

reviews.author: Marc Sprague
reviews.text: I had a transmission fully professionally built & had it dropped off here. When I went to have it put into my truck they tried to tell me some story to cover up that they sold it to someone else. I had lot my time ND money into tranny.

reviews.author: Ali Woodard
reviews.text: Been coming here for a long time, they offer great work and prices are reasonable. Everyone is friendly

reviews.author: Landen B
reviews.text: I’ve been to this shop before for smaller exhaust work on my truck but i had them change out a much larger portion on my car. I spent $400 and i thought everything came out well for the sound but after recently taking the car to the shop I discovered that they decided to cut corners and not form the pipes to the heat shield. So often times the exhaust will scrape and the car isn’t even lowered but on its stock ride height with very thick tires. Very disappointed in the rush of the process considering the price.

reviews.author: Robert Parkhurst
reviews.text: I am extremely satisfied with the service I had done. My exhaust system was in need of repair. They set an appointment up for me and took my car in almost immediately after I arrived. The mechanic was extremely diligent and thorough. I will recommend A-1 to everyone. They took care of the problem and the price was outstanding for both parts and labor. Thank you gentlemen!

reviews.author: Kim Clayton
reviews.text: They had our van for over 3 months and I can't even tell you how many times they have had it since we started having issues with the transmission back in 2019. Too damn many is all I can say. Seems like they didn't fix it just so we would have to bring it back. and this last time we were promised that it would fixed and that they were working on trying to figure out what the problem was with it. We were told oh this is being done and that is being done... Then the last time we were even told that the person that was working on it no longer works there. So for three months we were LIED TO!!! Then also come to find out that they wanted us to get this pay them $1800 to make things right, fix the problem even though they never laid a hand on it to figure out exactly what is/was wrong and for us to get our van back. My husband is fully disabled and we depend on our van and now it isn't even driveable. Then when my husband calls the shop two weeks ago checking in on the status of the repairs when we found out that they were trying to change us for something that wasn't fixed the first time, the owner was in the background cursing my husband, who never said one nasty or out of context word not even the first time to be treated like this???? The icing on the cake is that we now have our van back in the driveway NOT ABLE TO BE DRIVEN. What kind of shop does this to their customers you ask??? A-1 TRANSMISSION!!! We even had a friend who took his truck to them and they assured him that they were trying to figure out exactly what was wrong with it and ready for this???? Called him and asked him how do you start your truck???? WHAT WAIT A MINUTE ARE YOU KIDDING ME?!? How can one company do this to their customers and still be in or stay in business??? UNBELIEVABLE And a side note the only reason I left a star is because I had to in order to post this review

reviews.author: Chuck Mayes
reviews.text: Absolutely phenomenal work! Great people great service. Danny did an excellent job on my corvette. Price was more than fair. I love dealing with local businesses. They will get all my exhaust work.

reviews.author: Joey Brown
reviews.text: Highly recommend this shop. Moved here not too long ago, so wasn’t entirely sure where to go. My exhaust had rusted and split. I got there shortly after 12 and had to wait for everyone to get back from lunch (but that was explained to me ahead of time and I had no problem waiting) - I’d just recommend getting here before 12 or after 1. Anyways - Danny worked on my exhaust, showed me everything on the car before he did anything, told me his plan and allowed me to watch his work (from a safe distance). Danny was great - Honest guy and I appreciate the work! Very affordable and my car is running great and sounds so much better now.

reviews.author: Kenneth Flowers
reviews.text: Great guys fair pricing and most of all they get the job done. Just this week they did a great job on my car install a clutch kit and transmission that was busted I will always take my car to these guys best around period Darrell and his crew are the greatest at diagnosing the problem and fixing it bottom line. Also fixed my car and truck within the same week they are fast and will get you up and going again these guys treat you right and will save you money can’t beat them.

reviews.author: Donna
reviews.text: They have always treated me right when I go here. Usually go for inspections and they always try to get me in asap, even though they are usually pretty busy. Which, I think that speaks for itself. All his customers can't be wrong. lol They do good work.

reviews.author: AV Transportation
reviews.text: These guy’s are the Best in Hickory and most affordable in my opinion! Only thing is you gotta make an appointment!

reviews.author: Jimmy Gillman
reviews.text: Called for a price, it was fair and i was told to come on in they'd work me in. So I drove the 45 minutes to get there only to wait 30 minutes before even talking to anyone and even then I had to step up and say something. Come to find out the man I spoke with on the phone had left ( apparently he was the manager or something like that) without saying anything to anyone. Then they told me they won't be able to get to me and that was it! They jumped to someone else like I wasn't even there. Little did they know the work I was having done was temporary and was about to have my whole exhaust system upgraded, which would have been good easy money for them. But oh well!

reviews.author: Tim H
reviews.text: Good down-to-earth folks. Stopped by for an estimate and information about putting a Flowmaster muffler on my truck. They had the part in stock and did the work while I waited, for a very reasonable price. Overall quite satisfied with the whole process.

reviews.author: William MacLachlan
reviews.text: Did a full custom exhaust on my 2006 mini Cooper S, did a beautiful job and made it look and sound 10X better. I will definitely bring my other exhaust jobs here from now on. Fantastic crew works here, friendly fast service for a great price.

reviews.author: Matthew Lipscomb
reviews.text: Awesome place! They do general work as well as exhaust and muffler repair. The owner and his right hand man are two old salts that's forgotten more about cars than most technicians will ever know. Not to mention there prices are super low. Seriously if you need work done, don't think twice before bringing your car here.

reviews.author: Sean Wescott
reviews.text: Very friendly people with a great work ethic. Quality work at affordable prices. They only did what I wanted done and did not try to upsale me. Good place to go for muffler/exhaust work as well as standard mechanical needs.

reviews.author: Anthony Church
reviews.text: This was my first time using A1 Muffler. Danny did some exhaust work for me & I’ll have to say, you CANNOT beat the value for the money that you get here. Danny & Darrell are just a couple good ole boys who definitely know what they’re doing when it comes to vehicles. I had a pleasant experience & I would definitely go back. Two thumbs up.

reviews.author: Usbaldo Huitron
reviews.text: Did good and quick work welding on a new exhaust. I even had it begin to rattle the next day, and they made sure they fixed it free of charge. Some great people here, and I will be coming back.

reviews.author: Michelle Slape
reviews.text: They fit me in at the last minute for a brake job and we're cheaper than where I was going to go. They were very friendly. The owner took time to talk to me and get to know me. They will now be my mechanics. Very trustworthy

reviews.author: LaToya LDeAnn Sloan
reviews.text: Rudeness, my brother was told a previous price then once he got there they told him differently. Unprofessional and disrespectful. They need to get some manners because the man’s actions were uncalled for. My brothers car is running good though.

reviews.author: Eric Bost
reviews.text: The guys at A-1 Muffler did an amazing job installing my magnaflow muffler and discovering exhaust leaks. They fixed the leaks and made the car sound amazing. Very friendly and thorough in their work. It's nice to do business with people who care about their work. Will do business again. Highly suggested!

reviews.author: Joe Spears AF1E
reviews.text: They told me I needed to replace my muffler and they did. Now several months later when I heard engine noise, I learn that not only did they not replace my muffler they covered the old muffler and made several welds messing up the whole exhause system so I am having to completely replace my exhaust system including my muffler and catalytic converters. In sum, don't trust them or their work. Price may be low but the quality is even lower.

reviews.author: James Freeman
reviews.text: I went to A1- MUFFLER on Thursday 12/22/2022 to have a new muffler installed on my suv I arrived that morning and as usual, I received ( A-1- SERVICE ) and a JOB VERY WELL DONE I waited for my suv the staff is GREAT they treat you like FAMILY. BIG THANK YOU

reviews.author: Alisha Gilliland
reviews.text: Went in to get my muffler repaired. The older gentleman was nice but a little dismissive. He ended up just kind of leaving but Andrew came out and was very polite, he had my car fixed in less than an hour and my car sounds 10x better

reviews.author: Patrick Duncan
reviews.text: Darrell the Manager owner is always fair and charges way less than any dealer and works hard to get the job done. They do it all from engine replacement, oil change any everything else except transmissions. They do clutches. Muffler work is less expensive than anyone in 10 counties.

reviews.author: Bo Weichel
reviews.text: These guys do great work and are quick. Reasonable prices and great service. Can't beat that. Anything from oil changes to diagnosing an issue they are always very helpful.

reviews.author: Wally Suarez
reviews.text: I took my chevy truck to different places and they told me the manifold was bad, but they didn't help me, they told me to find the part and they may fix it, so i took it to A-1 and they find the real problem , they fix it and my truck is running nice and smooth, and for all the hard work i know they went thru fixing a old truck head gasket with some broken bolts, what they charge me was a fraction of the price i though i had to pay, great job guys, i would highly recommend this place! thank you so much!

reviews.author: Greg Moser
reviews.text: A-1 Muffler & Service Center did an outstanding job on my truck! The service was quick, efficient, and courteous! The service was awesome and the cost was extremely fair. I have found my new muffler and exhaust service center and I highly recommend this center.

reviews.author: Brad Ralphs
reviews.text: Friendly staff and fast service, particularly from Martin who discussed my preferences (custom exhaust work) and didn't complain when I asked for a modification. Prices were competitive - will visit them again!

reviews.author: Shawn Tollefson
reviews.text: I have had many encounters with a1 and each one somehow manages to top the last. They are the only people I trust with my vehicles. These guys actually know what they are doing, they aren't out to get people for money and they are the nicest guys! I would recommend them to anyone in a heart beat

reviews.author: Scott Haynes
reviews.text: Did work work on my F150 paid for parts and labor only to find out a few weeks later that only HALF of the parts that I was charged for had been replaced 1300.00 paid to Darrell as soon as the supposed repairs were made!! I never questioned his integrity or the integrity of his mechanics!! BUT MY TRUCK STARTED HAVING THE SAME SYMPTOMS AS IT DID PRIOR TO SUPPOSED REPAIRS. So I PERSONALLY STARTED MY OWN INVESTIGATION AS TO WHAT WAS GOING ON… and IT WAS THEN WHEN I REALIZED THAT I HAD BEEN FLAT OUT CHEATED OUT OF 1300,00. I grew up working on my own vehicles but as I’ve gotten older I prefer to pay a GARAGE to do the work… SO I DO HAVE ENOUGH TO KNOWLEDGE TO KNOW WHEN A PART HASNT BEEN REPLACED IN THIS CASE THERE WERE A FEW… I WILL BE TAKING LEGAL ACTION!! CONSUMER BEWARE ….BAD BUSINESS PRACTICES AND SHADY MECHANICS!!! DONT DO IT… I can ALMOST PROMISE YOU THAT HIS BUSINESS IS SOLELY SUPPORTED BY RETURN CUSTOMERS WHOM CONSTANTLY HAVE REPAIRS MADE ARE BECAUSE OF ISSUES INTENTIONALLY CREATED BY THE GARAGE..: BOTTOM LINE IS …ITS FRAUD AND I HAVE DOCUMENTED PROOF OF EVERYTHING THAT I HAVE SUBMITTED IN THIS REVIEW!!! Will be REPORTING AND FILLING A COMPLAINT TO THE BBB AND THE NC DOJ OFFICE “… BUSINESSES LIKE THIS NEED TO BE SHUT DOWN PERIOD!!! I WOULDN’T RATE THEM AT ALL IF I HAD THAT OPTION!!! CROOKS!!! IF YOU CONSTANTLY HAVE TO HAVE REPAIRS DONE BY THE SAME GARAGE ON THE SAME VEHICLE then chances are YOU ARE FRAUDULENTLY BEING CATFISHED !!!

reviews.author: CD'S Automotive Garage
reviews.text: They were busy but that will happen . I Never been here before an was a little bit of a drive to get there but noone else could get my exhaust done today so I called them an they got me in an done an I'm happy an car sounds good an looks good underneath for the exhaust. Will be back if I ever need anything else .

reviews.author: Wang Her
reviews.text: I had them weld a new catalytic converter on my car. When they were almost done the mechanic came to me and said we about done just need to bring down from the lift and she is all yours. I see my car up the lift. Okay, I paid.... 30 minutes later no car. No one was in the lobby so I went to the bay and saw they were working on my driver door. The mechanic left the door open and when the brought the car down the door jam on there roll cart. Breaking the hinge off. They didnt even let me know and try to fix it. They say ohh umm we got someone coming to quote us on the damage. First of all you're trying to fix it now. The door is almost detached, and most importantly you didnt even let me know. The boss there is a complete a$$, didnt give me a discount or refund, didnt even give me a rental, but offer me to pay for the damage. I cant drive my car like that anywhere. So long story short (call insurance company) they solve the matter. A-1 are bad ,cheap, shady, people

reviews.author: Alexia Wimberly
reviews.text: Very friendly and quick service. But a little pricey I paid 210$ For catalytic converter replacement. But I would recommend this place to my friends.

reviews.author: wally Souarez
reviews.text: I had a hard time with my truck for a long time , after taking it to different places without success! I try a-1 and they diagnosed the problem right away, they fix it , and my truck is running nice and smooth! I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Michael Hart
reviews.text: More than fair prices,honest and mostly competent, professional services served. For me ,Good old boy folks that I would recommend to anyone. Trustworthy for SURE.

reviews.author: Thomas Brandt
reviews.text: I highly recommend anyone to this place, excellent service and professional treatment. The employees were very reasonable and the price was unbeatable. Thank you A-1 Muffler Services!

reviews.author: Sai Lor
reviews.text: Highly recommended. Great place and price. Charged me 15$ for a simple exhaust weld Will definitely go there again

reviews.author: Josh Fisher
reviews.text: Called about wanting to take my rear mufflers off not sure who I spoke with but they wouldn’t agree to take them off because my mid mufflers were already taken off I’m aware that I can’t pass inspection, not sure why you would deny a service into making money, will be taking my business else where.

reviews.author: Asian Ness
reviews.text: Really good muffler shop! I would recommend this shop for anyone.. helped me and knowledge me through the whole process. Parking little cramp, but that doesn't matter.. Good job! (Custom exhaust work)

reviews.author: Bryan
reviews.text: Super Friendly Staff.. Owner Was Great.. Sits Right In Lobby And Conversates With Customers! Very VERY Reasonable Rates!

reviews.author: Arvin Foes
reviews.text: Excellent service. Staff is very friendly. Work was done in a timely manner. Would recommend highly.

reviews.author: Joshua Chirita
reviews.text: Quick service, no appointment needed. Professional staff. These guys are great and I'll be back for future work.

reviews.author: H.A. Rob
reviews.text: Installed a Borla exhaust on my Stinger. Great work, professional, reasonable, fast and kind. Would definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Chris Millsaps
reviews.text: I came in to see when they could look at my exhaust problem and they fixed my problem within a couple of hours. I didn't expect to get anything done,so I'm very satisfied.

reviews.author: Darrell Canipe
reviews.text: They were prompt, precise, friendly and involved me in my decisions as what to repair and reasonably priced.

reviews.author: Jordan Pharr
reviews.text: They will do you right no matter what the job is. Had a flowmaster installed on my truck very reasonable.

reviews.author: Gary Hoffman
reviews.text: I had two problems with my van and they fixed both of them. I spent less than$100. They were busy but they worked us in.

reviews.author: Michael Michael
reviews.text: Did some exhaust work on my car, Great work no disappointment at all sounds great, highly recommended.

reviews.author: Teddy Weaver
reviews.text: Staff was very respectful on handling the situation that occur for my vehicle will work with you about any problems before any work is done.

reviews.author: Banny Vongphachanh
reviews.text: Had them do exhaust work, the weld was horrible and also had a leak which I didn’t knew about till I had took it back to them.

reviews.author: Bobby Henry
reviews.text: Compared to other muffler shops this place don't try and RIP off their customers, they do great work and they asked the customers to come out into the work area to show them the problems that's going on with the vehicle.

reviews.author: Marcus P
reviews.text: These fellas know their stuff. I've taken several vehicles for exhaust upgrades over the years. Out with the old!

reviews.author: Sam Edmisten
reviews.text: These folks have been taking care of my car for 20 years now. I have over 355,000 miles on my Honda and with A-1s help I plan to make it to half a million miles.

reviews.author: Rodney Long
reviews.text: Suggested I go i to the shop and see what my exhaust was leaking and suggested several options for repair.
